title: The Negotiation Process
author: 637a4e2c89ac12120fbab5de
chapter_outcomes: Understand what negotiation is as a process that can involve: resolving disputes, agreeing upon courses of action, bargaining for individual or collective advantage, reaching outcomes to satisfy the interests of those involved
Explain stages in the negotiation process which focus on planning, conducting the negotiation, measuring success
Explain planning as setting objectives, choosing evidence to use, benefits of a proposal, weaknesses of a proposal, arguments and counter-arguments for the proposal
Explain conducting the negotiation as setting the tone, presenting your proposal, understanding each other's point of view, summarising to check understanding, reaching agreement
Explain measuring success as what went well, how to improve next time
